# Expense Tracker: know what you can deduct, before tax time

> Free expense tracker for freelancers and the self-employed: log expenses, import a bank CSV, see deductible totals by Schedule C line and by quarterly payment period, flag missing receipts. No account, works offline, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
